system.description: By willingly sacrificing one permanent Blood Trait (returned to the caster when the enspelled ghoul dies) and branding the ghoul with his sigil, the thaumaturge ensures the ghoul revives as a Kindred within 10 minutes of any death. If another vampire Embraces the enspelled ghoul, the mortal rises as the childe of the ritualist instead. The inaccessible Blood Trait cannot be used to power Disciplines while the ritual is active.
system.duration: Until the ghoul dies or is Embraced
